document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You have one chance to fire before the things pull you off-
balance and into the pit. Despite the range being point-blank, 
the darkness negates any bonus die you would have had, so your 
chance to hit is Regular. Each ghast has 3 points of armor. If you 
can hit and wound one, both will quickly retreat and fade away 
into the darkness, and you can jump back to 303. If you inflict 
no damage, you miss your chance to fend them off, go to 369.
(355)
